infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Solace uses your microphone to record voice messages for your loved ones.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Solace uses your camera to record video messages for your loved ones.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Solace accesses your photo library so you can choose a video to save as a memory.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Solace uses speech recognition so you can speak your stories and memories instead of typing.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Solace Life to access your microphone to record voice memos for your loved ones.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Solace Life to access your photos to create memory albums.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Solace Life to use your camera to record video messages.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Solace Life to access your contacts so you can quickly add family members without typing.
